name: AdvancedWeather3D
author: Twillion
shortDescription: Modular 3D rain, snow, fog, hail, embers, dust and shelter effects for bounded or follow-camera weather zones.
description: Attach dedicated RainVolume3D, SnowVolume3D, ClusteredFogVolume3D, HailVolume3D, EmbersVolume3D, DustVolume3D, or universal WeatherVolume3D behaviors to a 3D Box or 3D Object. Features velocity-aligned streaks, vector-combined local/global wind, floor and roof splashes, hail rebounds, fluttering snow, raymarched volumetric fog with adjustable quality, shared lightning illumination, and WeatherShelter3D roof occlusion.

eventsFunctions.name: SetGlobalWind
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set global weather wind (Speed: _PARAM0_, Direction: _PARAM1_ degrees)
eventsFunctions.description: Set global wind speed and direction affecting all weather volumes in the scene.

eventsFunctions.name: SetGlobalSpeedMultiplier
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set global weather simulation speed multiplier to _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Speed up, slow down, or freeze weather simulation across all volumes (1.0 = normal, 0.0 = pause).

eventsFunctions.name: GlobalWindSpeed
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the global wind speed offset.

eventsFunctions.name: GlobalWindDirection
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the global wind direction in degrees.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: RainVolume3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Attach to a 3D Box (Cube) or 3D Object. Sizing the cube defines a 3D rain zone with velocity-aligned streaks, 3D wind pitch, floor splash ripples, and lightning.

propertyDescriptors.name: VolumeMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Volume Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: BoundedBox: strictly confined inside 3D cube. FollowCamera: camera-centered emitter with world-anchored particles and ripples.

propertyDescriptors.name: HideHostMesh
propertyDescriptors.label: Hide Host Cube Mesh
propertyDescriptors.description: Automatically hides the 3D box renderer mesh at runtime.

propertyDescriptors.name: DebugBounds
propertyDescriptors.label: Show Debug Wireframe
propertyDescriptors.description: Draw a bounding wireframe cage around the volume.

propertyDescriptors.name: ParticleDensity
propertyDescriptors.label: Drop Count / Density
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of raindrops simulated in the volume.

propertyDescriptors.name: ParticleSpeed
propertyDescriptors.label: Fall Speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Terminal downward fall speed in units/second.

propertyDescriptors.name: ParticleSpeedVariation
propertyDescriptors.label: Speed Variation
propertyDescriptors.description: Random fall speed variance (0.0 = uniform, 1.0 = high variation).

propertyDescriptors.name: StreakLength
propertyDescriptors.label: Streak Length
propertyDescriptors.description: Rain streak elongation length along velocity vector.

propertyDescriptors.name: StreakThickness
propertyDescriptors.label: Streak Thickness
propertyDescriptors.description: Raindrop streak cross-section width in scene units.

propertyDescriptors.name: WindSpeed
propertyDescriptors.label: Wind Speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Wind velocity force in scene units/second.

propertyDescriptors.name: WindDirection
propertyDescriptors.label: Wind Azimuth Direction

propertyDescriptors.name: WindPitch

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: ClusteredFogVolume3D
